newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca fungicide has U.S. registration.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca fungicide has U.S. registration.

text.p: Britain's Zeneca Group Plc said on Monday its new fungicide, azoxystrobin, had been granted its first U.S. registration.
The Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) has approved its use on turfgrass for the control of several economically important diseases, Zeneca said in a statement.
Azoxystrobin will be marketed as "Heritage' in the U.S. turfgrass market and will be launched in February, 1997.

Zeneca said Heritage had been approved 20 months after submission of the regulatory data and had been designated as a reduced risk pesticide. It said the turfgrass market, valued at $150 million, is the largest segment of the U.S. fungicide market, valued at $750 million.
